title: Particle Lib
description: Adds useful tools for developers to do with particles
body:
Adds a library of tools for working with particles.

Such as Spawning a circle or cylinder from one line of code instead of using 1 line for all particles.

<details>
<summary>Dev------</summary>

rabbdude1.particlelib.particle.ParticleHelper;

using the class above you can access the tools.

</details>
